test_model_addition_debugger_outputs: test model_addition_debugger_context to generate debug tree summary and full tensor JSON files for a PyTorch model
test_layer_pruning_behavior_no_pruning: test model_addition_debugger_context with do_prune_layers=False to capture all layers in the debug tree
test_layer_pruning_behavior_with_pruning: test model_addition_debugger_context with do_prune_layers=True to capture only selected layers in the debug tree
summarize_model_addition_debugger_contex: summarize the model_addition_debugger_context utility that instruments a PyTorch nn.Module to log inputs and outputs as JSON debug trees
review_toy_model_debugging: review the ToyModel and ToyModelWithLayers test models used to validate model_addition_debugger_context behavior
